digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler outbound comment deduplication and enactment
propositions: The outbound comment dedup key is computed by one composition of functions in the differ but the send path uses a different independent composition in each adapter, causing convergence bugs when the two drift.

The dedup key currently predicts the wire bytes the send path will produce rather than being derived from the bytes actually sent, requiring three separately-maintained fit compositions to stay in lockstep.

Both mutation enactment consumers (create path in dispatch_one.py and update path in dispatch_apply_phases.py) must be updated to send wire_body instead of the unfitted body to prevent the dedup key from diverging at send time.
The adapter's fit must remain idempotent: re-fitting an already-fitted body must return it byte-identical so the key remains valid after the defensive adapter fit runs.
fit_for_send must return both landed_text (the dedup key, derived from the bytes sent) and wire_body (the pre-encoded text with decorations and fit applied) to break the composition-drift obligation.
